convert_rgb_to_hsv: convert an RGB image tensor to HSV color space using JAX numpy operations
convert_hsv_to_rgb: convert an HSV image tensor back to RGB color space using JAX numpy operations
convert_rgb_to_hsl: convert an RGB image tensor to HSL color space using JAX numpy operations
convert_hsl_to_rgb: convert an HSL image tensor back to RGB color space using JAX numpy operations
convert_rgb_to_grayscale: convert an RGB image to grayscale using rec601, rec709, or bt2001 luma standards
